content.title: Zvonimir Ivisic - 2025-26 - Men's Basketball
content.text: University of Illinois Athletics Main Navigation Menu Sport Navigation Menu Biography 2025-26 JUNIOR Played in all 36 games with four starts Averaging 6.6 points, 4.6 rebounds, 0.3 assists, and 2.0 blocks per game Eight games in double-figures scoring and two games with 10+ rebounds Ranks fourth nationally in block rate at 12.6% 16 games with a 3-pointers, including nine games with multiple triples Nine points and a team-high seven rebounds in B1G Tournament vs. #23 Wisconsin (3/13) Eight points (2-2 FT), five rebounds and two blocks in win vs. Oregon (3/3) 11 points (4-6 FG), three rebounds, and two blocks at UCLA (2/21) Nine rebounds (three offensive) and three blocks with four points vs. Wisconsin (2/10) Team-high eight rebounds with five points and three blocks at Michigan State (2/7) 13 points (3-5 3FG) and seven rebounds (five offensive) in win vs. Northwestern (2/4) Seven points (3-3 FG), seven rebounds and two blocks in win at #5 Nebraska (2/1) Season-high 19 points (6-6 FTs) with nine rebounds (four offensive) in win vs. Minnesota (1/17) Eight points in win at #19 Iowa (1/11) 10 rebounds and five blocks to go with six points in win vs. Penn State (1/3) at The Palestra 13 points (3-5 3FG) and three blocks vs. Southern (12/29) Eight points (4-6 FT), season-high 11 rebounds, and three blocks in win vs. Missouri (12/22) 13 points (3-4 FT), eight rebounds, and one block in win at Ohio State (12/9) Eight points in nine minutes on 3-3 FG (2-2 3FG) in win vs. #13 Tennessee (12/6) Game-high five blocks with four points and one steal vs. #5 UConn (11/28) 10 points, seven rebounds and a block vs. UTRGV (11/24) 11 points and team-high seven rebounds and three blocks in win over #11 Texas Tech (11/11) 16 points, nine rebounds and seven blocks - tied for second-most blocks in program history - in first Illini start vs. Florida Gulf Coast (11/7) Naismith Defensive Player of the Year watch list candidate 2024-25 SOPHOMORE (AT ARKANSAS) Played in 35 games with 19 starts for Arkansas Helped lead the Razorbacks to an NCAA Sweet 16 appearance Averaged 8.5 points and 4.3 rebounds in 19 minutes per game Shot a team-best 37.6% (47-125) from 3-point range Registered a team-high 66 blocks (1.9 per game), ranking second in the SEC Ranked 16th nationally in block percentage (10.47%), according to kenpom Scored in double-figures 16 times with three 20-point games, all during SEC play Scored a career-high 27 points vs. No. 3 Alabama (2/8/25) 2023-24 FRESHMAN (AT KENTUCKY) Missed the first 16 games before becoming eligible on Jan. 20, 2024 Made his debut for the Wildcats against Georgia Appeared in 15 games, averaging 5.5 points, 3.3 rebounds and 1.3 blocks per game Connected on 57.7% from the field, 37.5% from 3-point range and 77.3% from the charity stripe Recorded four double-figure scoring efforts Led UK in rebounding three times and blocks in seven games Tallied four games with three or more rejections Had best game of the season vs. No. 13 Alabama, scoring a season-high 18 points on a season-best seven made field goals, while also leading the team with a season-high four rejections in 20 minutes against the Tide Pulled down a season-high nine boards while going a season-best 6-of-7 at the free throw line vs. Arkansas, also adding 12 points and two blocks Scored seven points and blocked three shots vs. Texas A&M in the SEC Tournament Played a season-high in minutes for the second straight game with 21 minutes of action at Mississippi State while registering a team-high three blocks Scored 11 points in 12 minutes, adding a team-high seven boards, in a road win at Vanderbilt Led the team in blocks in each of his first two games played Made collegiate debut vs. Georgia, scoring 13 points in 16 minutes, draining a trio of 3-pointers, while also leading the team with three blocks and tying for the team lead with five rebounds CLUB Averaged 11.4 points, 5.3 rebounds and 3.4 blocks per game in the FIBA U20 European Championship for his home country of Croatia, while also shooting 34% from 3-point range and averaging nearly 20 minutes a game Played two seasons for SC Derby in Montenegro where he averaged 5.2 points, 3.5 rebounds and 1.1 blocks per game in the Adriatic League During the playoffs for SC Derby, he produced his best outing with 22 points, 13 rebounds and three blocks against European League side Partizan PERSONAL Born Aug. 9, 2003 Parents are Mladen and Marina Ivisic Majoring in communication at Illinois Twin brother (older by four minutes) of Illini C Tomislav Ivisic Also has an older brother, Nikola, and an older sister, Jelena Lists brother Tomislav as his life’s greatest influence
